doc_a.text:
Lab comparison notes for SweepNest S7+:
- (5/5) SweepNest S7+ mapped a 95 m² flat in one pass and resumed after a forced dock without remapping in three of three trials.
- (4/5) Edge brush + side sensor combo left ≤2 cm untreated strip along baseboards on hardwood in a chalk-dust grid test.

doc_b.text:
Lab comparison notes for FloorPilot Max:
- (5/5) FloorPilot Max lifted carpets then mopped hard floors in one job, finishing a mixed-surface run 12 minutes faster than SweepNest on the same floorplan.
- (4/5) Obstacle avoidance skipped charging cables and a shoe in 9/10 scripted placements without stuck recovery.
- (3/5) Mop pad wash cycle on the dock removed visible coffee residue after a kitchen spill simulation.
